items.description: three ivory bone chew toys joined radially around one coral red hub like a small bone wheel
three sky blue flying discs joined in a triangle around a cream hub, clear separate overlapping discs
one ochre braided rope octopus dog toy, central round knot and six short rope tentacles, no face
one shallow sky blue pet wash basin and three translucent light blue soap bubbles rising over it, no animal

job.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW four-object game sprite sheet for an existing cozy animal rescue mobile game. Image 1 defines ONLY the blank canvas and four cell centers. Image 2 is the actual yard STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match gentle watercolor washes, subtle colored-pencil contours, matte paper grain INSIDE objects, spring sage greens, warm cream and muted coral. Objects must blend with a hand-painted courtyard, readable at 30 to 90 pixels. Slight three-quarter overhead view about 50 degrees unless specified. Natural believable proportions. No glossy plastic, no heavy black outline, no comic eyes unless specified.  Draw these objects at their exact positions: TOP LEFT: three ivory bone chew toys joined radially around one coral red hub like a small bone wheel; TOP RIGHT: three sky blue flying discs joined in a triangle around a cream hub, clear separate overlapping discs; BOTTOM LEFT: one ochre braided rope octopus dog toy, central round knot and six short rope tentacles, no face; BOTTOM RIGHT: one shallow sky blue pet wash basin and three translucent light blue soap bubbles rising over it, no animal. Arrange exactly FOUR separate free-floating objects in TWO columns and TWO rows. Top-left at (25%,25%), top-right (75%,25%), bottom-left (25%,75%), bottom-right (75%,75%). Each object must occupy no more than 65% of its cell, fully visible with generous white margins. Everything outside the object must be perfectly plain PURE WHITE #ffffff. No ground plane, no cast shadow, no enclosing tile, no sticker border, no frame, no grid lines. No letters, captions, numbers, logos, UI or watermark. Do not include courtyard scenery or animals. Keep all four objects separate and leave the spaces between them pure white.
job.negative: text, captions, numbers, tile frames, border, grid lines, checkerboard, shadow, ground plane, scenery, animals, photorealistic, 3d render, glossy, plastic, black thick outlines, watermark
